title: Test a complete fictional SliQ export without writes
public_pr_body:
Add an entirely fictional ten-file SliQ export: two customers, supplier, product, quote, PO, invoice/line, partial payment, linked credit note and allocation. All mailboxes use example.test. Cover BOM/padded headers, blank rows, quoted commas, oversized amounts, unknown invoice links and an extra report-banner row.

Exercise both the importer analysis and independent read-only reconciliation engine. Check exact pennies (72000 - 12000 - 6000 = 54000), retained source hashes, refused overflow and an explicit blocker against a deliberately mismatched fake target. No write mode, database or real data is used.

Base: codex2/sliq-more-tests (#193), incorporating #181's numeric validation without changing its behavior. Validation: 132 parser/reconciliation tests passed; typecheck and targeted ESLint passed. No new parse bug was found. Live DB import not run; no SQL applied.
